description: This file implements callback management for TorchDynamo's compilation process, including registration, execution, and thread-safe handling of start and end callbacks, along with decorators and a context manager.

classes.name: CallbackTrigger
classes.description: Enumeration of different callback trigger types for TorchDynamo compilation.

classes.name: CallbackArgs
classes.description: Data class holding callback trigger type and compile ID.

classes.name: CompilationCallbackHandler
classes.description: Class managing registration, execution, and thread safety of compile start/end callbacks.

methods.name: register_start_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called at compilation start.

methods.name: register_end_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called at compilation end.

methods.name: install_callbacks
methods.description: Context manager to install and run callbacks with thread safety.
